narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the psychological concept of growth versus fixed mindsets. By citing a specific research experiment from New York, it demonstrates how praising effort leads to better performance and resilience compared to praising innate intelligence, encouraging a change in social reinforcement habits.
